title: Rawalpindi, Punjab — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Rawalpindi is a city in Punjab with a population of 2,300,000. A major military and industrial city adjacent to Islamabad, serving as a key transportation hub in northern Punjab. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 265 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.0.
